Mr. Pradeep Kumar Chauhan (through V.C.)
and Mr. Hemant Singh Dangwal, Advocates for

2. Mr. Sunil Datt Joshi, Advocate, holding
brief of Ms. Menka Tripathi, Advocate for
respondent no. 1.
3. Mr. S.S. Chaudhary, Standing Counsel for
the State/respondent no. 2.
4. Petitioner participated in a selection for
appointment to the position of Assistant
Professor (Sanskrit) held by Uttarakhand Public
Service Commission. Her candidature was
rejected vide order dated 17.09.2024, passed
by Secretary, Uttarakhand Public Service
Commission on the ground that she furnished
educational certificates two months after the
deadline fixed for that purpose.
5. Petitioner contends that she was initially
not shortlisted, however, she was screened in,
in the subsequent shortlisting, but she was not
informed that she has been shortlisted based

2026:UHC:6955-DB
on her API score.
6. A supplementary counter affidavit is filed
by Mr. Ashok Kumar Pandey, Secretary,
Uttarakhand Public Service Commission,
enclosing therewith notification dated
07.06.2024, which was published in all leading
newspapers, whereby the candidates, who were
screened in, in the second shortlisting process
were asked to supply all educational
testimonials, on or before 24.06.2024.
7. Perusal of the said notification indicates
that list of candidates, who were shortlisted in
the second process of shortlisting, was
uploaded in the official website of the
Commission, therefore, the contention raised
by petitioner that she was not informed about
fate of her candidature cannot be accepted. The
fact remains that she furnished educational
testimonials two months after the deadline
fixed therefor, therefore, Commission was
justified in not considering her candidature for
appointment.
8. Thus, there is no scope for interference.
The writ petition fails and is dismissed.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 06.08.2026
